newsitem.title: CHINA: China warns against "excessive" stock purchases.
newsitem.headline: China warns against "excessive" stock purchases.

text.p: China's securities regulators have warned against excessive stock purchases by investors and they called on stock exchanges and securities firms to tighten supervision of funds for new share purchases, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

It said that the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the nation's securities watchdog, said in a circular that irregularities had emerged with some investors buying more shares than they could afford.
Xinhua did not say how it would be determined what was affordable for investors.
The news agency said all funds for new stock subscriptions must be frozen in the accounts of lead underwriters. It did not give further details.
The report appeared to be a restatement of an earlier notice by market regulators aimed at curtailing the use of overdrafts for the purchase of new shares.
